card.title: We Keep Switching Places
card.instruction: Return to a familiar relationship pattern, then reverse who performs each role whenever the scene reaches similar pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The projector's dead. Usually I talk you down, but today I need you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can use my laptop. Nobody's going to die.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep saying that while I imagine twelve directors sharing one screen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My laptop's dead too. We're finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody's going to die. I'll print twelve copies; you sit down before we need thirteen.

mechanism: A and B reverse their familiar reassurance and panic roles as successive presentation devices fail.
confusable: Unlike one person recovering composure, the same pressure must transfer the panicked role to the other partner.
comparison: S225-b repeats the reassurance phrase after B's laptop fails; S225-a trades the physical repair role after the valve sticks.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
